KJV renders: dedicate, train up.
bdb: חָנַךְ vb. train up, dedicate
[חֲנֻכָּה] n.f. dedication
חֲנֻכָּה n.f. dedication, consecration, as a matter of usage only P and late (NH חֲנוּכָּה Feast of Dedication)
חֲנֹכִי adj.gent. only c. art. = subst. coll. Nu 26:5.
